rules.R1: Commit messages must start with `[gw] ` (bracket prefix, then a space), e.g. `[gw] add TTL to store`.
rules.R2: When you return an error received from another call, wrap it as `fmt.Errorf("gw: <funcName>: %w", err)`; never return it bare.
rules.R3: Name every new test file `<name>_internal_test.go`, not plain `<name>_test.go`.
rules.R4: Log with `log/slog` only, never the `log` package or `fmt.Println`; every slog call must include a `"component"` attribute.
rules.R5: Every exported function or method you add needs a doc comment whose last words are `(owner: core)`.
rules.R6: Table-driven tests: name the slice `cases` and the loop variable `tc` (`for _, tc := range cases`).
rules.R7: Every change adds one bullet line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md.
rules.R8: Never call `time.Now()` directly in non-test code; use `clock.Now()` from `example.com/gw/internal/clock`.
